from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sales Data']

h = ws['H1']
h.value = 'Profit Margin'
src = ws['G1']
h.font = src.font.copy()
h.fill = src.fill.copy()
h.alignment = src.alignment.copy()
h.border = src.border.copy()

for r in range(2, 10):
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=8)
    cell.value = f'=G{r}/E{r}'
    src = ws[f'G{r}']
    cell.font = src.font.copy()
    cell.fill = src.fill.copy()
    cell.alignment = src.alignment.copy()
    cell.border = src.border.copy()
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'

cell = ws.cell(row=10, column=8)
cell.value = '=G10/E10'
src = ws['G10']
cell.font = src.font.copy()
cell.fill = src.fill.copy()
cell.alignment = src.alignment.copy()
cell.border = src.border.copy()
cell.number_format = '0.0%'

ws.column_dimensions['H'].width = 14

wb.save('sales_data.xlsx')
print('Saved')
EOF

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sales Data']

# Header in H1, styled to match existing headers (copy from G1)
h = ws['H1']
h.value = 'Profit Margin'
src = ws['G1']
h.font = src.font.copy()
h.fill = src.fill.copy()
h.alignment = src.alignment.copy()
h.border = src.border.copy()

# Data rows 2..9: Profit Margin % = Profit / Revenue
for r in range(2, 10):
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=8)
    cell.value = f'=G{r}/E{r}'
    src = ws[f'G{r}']
    cell.font = src.font.copy()
    cell.fill = src.fill.copy()
    cell.alignment = src.alignment.copy()
    cell.border = src.border.copy()
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'

# TOTAL row: blended margin = total profit / total revenue
cell = ws.cell(row=10, column=8)
cell.value = '=G10/E10'
src = ws['G10']
cell.font = src.font.copy()
cell.fill = src.fill.copy()
cell.alignment = src.alignment.copy()
cell.border = src.border.copy()
cell.number_format = '0.0%'

ws.column_dimensions['H'].width = 14

wb.save('sales_data.xlsx')
print('Saved: Profit Margin column added to H')
